actualCommand.execution: One direct Node process; no test process isolation or child launcher.

controls: Exact byte equivalence across arbitrary, empty and nonempty fragment boundaries.
Every-byte corruption, length mismatch and prefix/trailing bytes.
Invalid types and caps; accessors, sparse arrays, proxies and forged Buffer lengths.
Captured Buffer comparison is used after prototype replacement.
No whole expected Buffer concatenation during comparison.
All 32 complete synthetic profiles equal an independent whole JSON reference.
Noncanonical or reordered JSON bytes are not reinterpreted as equivalent.
limitations: Callers supply the complete expected encoded fields and their own source/profile admission.
This proves component DATA byte matching, not native preload integration or operational throughput.
No native heap, allocation-byte, latency or sustainable-capacity measurement was made.
Hosted CI for any main transfer must be observed independently.
